the clinical trials in Latin American countries have a negative impact on the population’s health and on the countries’ financial accessibility of medicines.

the clinical trials conducted in low and middle-income countries (LMICs) have no impact on the financial accessibility or safety of the medicines commercialized in those countries.

the pharmaceutical industry should not be allowed to test medicines in low and middle-income countries, and that clinical trials should only be conducted in high surveillance countries.
